epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease deliverable readiness calculation defect rate from 1 to 0
requirements: R1: The deliverable readiness ratio must correctly incorporate resolved items so that the metric reflects actual project progress rather than stagnating at ~67%.

slices.title: Patch deliverable readiness calculation logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the calculation patch for this epic, I want to accurately compute the readiness ratio from existing item states, so that the deliverable readiness stagnation bug is resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a set of deliverables with known resolved states
When the readiness ratio is computed
Then it accurately returns the proportion of resolved items to total items
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce metric calculation defects from 1 to 0

slices.title: Verify deliverable readiness calculation patch
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to test the patched readiness logic with unit and integration tests, so that the true progress is tracked without regressions.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the patched readiness calculation logic
When executed against datasets with varying resolved item counts in integration tests
Then it accurately computes the ratio and clears the stagnation warning state
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage for readiness calculation from 0% to 100%
